provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Read complete index.html, sources.md, independent verification.json, results.csv, prompts.json, CLAP repeat check, findings and versions; read retained licence texts/card. Local comparison only, no benchmark or network execution. MusicGen licence operative excerpt inspected at lines 105–160.
provenance.originalTestTimezone: Asia/Singapore; some raw logs/captures November 6 UTC
provenance.originalPrivacyBoundary: Anonymous public downloads; local-files-only offline inference with Python sockets disabled; no audio upload, accounts, cached HF tokens or personal browser session. This is retained original-run evidence, not a new run.

datePolicy: Source-specific original access is November 7, 2026 Asia/Singapore, as retained sources.md/findings.md state. UTC capture November 6 is preserved separately. Community agreement updated July 5, 2024; OpenRAIL licence dated August 22, 2022. Original publication date and model author identity remain unknown. Authoring is not a source refresh.
uncertainties: No tested model satisfied every condition; two completed five-prompt sets, one memory-limited attempt and one gated exclusion are not a four-model completed bake-off.
MusicGen NC and AudioLDM NC-SA weights do not clear monetised model use; no automatic output CC inheritance asserted. Code licence is separate.
Riffusion commercial permission remains use-restricted; research-intended card wording, no non-infringement warranty or Content ID clearance. No completed long clip within guard.

Stable Audio Open Small gated terms unavailable anonymously; public Community agreement is not exact checkpoint clearance. Commercial registration and aggregate revenue conditions apply; up to 11s is short of native long-clip request.

RSS and guard are not physical or whole-system memory. MPS physical footprint overshot; sampled stops can overshoot/miss peaks. Earlier completed clips have no retrospective physical-footprint measurements.
Riffusion direct Diffusers, widened spectrogram and marked torchaudio inverse-mel compatibility change mean not an untouched-default comparison. CPU float16 exploration is not a completed benchmark.
CLAP first-10s automated cosine is not quality, full-clip structure or narration-fit scoring. No listening impressions or panel invented.

Recorded original file metrics passed independent recomputation; historical wall times and memory cannot be remeasured from WAVs. No new generation, benchmark, browser test or external refresh performed.
English instrumental prompts only; no Chinese prompt, lyrics or Chinese-language output testing.
Saved page/audio/CSV/scripts are local draft-package attachments, not public hosting promises.
editingContract: Only assigned new en/zh Markdown, shared data JSON and batch25 notes. No existing file or source edits, shared inventory/README/manifest changes, builds, external research, contact or publication. No ratings or Review schema.
